title: Strengthen media output verification
summary: Added fail-closed source/output video topology verification, resolved audio/subtitle output-plan verification, remux Dynamic HDR preservation checks, and sidecar evidence for media and Dynamic HDR policy decisions.
reason: FFmpeg success and equal stream counts do not prove stream topology, metadata, policy conformance, or Dynamic HDR preservation before publish.
behavior_before: Remux and encode verification primarily used output existence, duration, count-based video preservation, and route-specific checks; remux Dynamic HDR preservation policies had no output-side preservation gate.
behavior_after: Publish is blocked on inconclusive or mismatched normalized video, audio, and subtitle inventories. Dynamic HDR remux preservation policies verify output side data fail-closed, while warn remains non-blocking with explicit unverified evidence.
manual_validation: Invoke-AdversarialForceKillEncodeChecks.ps1 - passed on repeat using generated media; no source or completed output was accepted
Representative real-media validation is pending and remains a release-acceptance gate.
rollback_plan: Revert this packet's PowerShell verifier, module-loader, test, documentation, and generated-summary changes together. Preserve the existing source-protection, scratch, and pending-publish paths; do not weaken failed verification into a publishable fallback.
